claims.statement: Tom Allen was in training at Barnet, on the Thames near London, in March 1878 under his trainer Jack Hopkins.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen has been in training about a week now
places: Barnet, on the Thames, near London

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Charley Davis were expected to meet for the championship and £200 at St. George's Hall, London, though the law had a great deal to do in the matter.
claims.excerpt: Blip the £200 and more beside, meet at St.

claims.statement: Tom Allen weighed fourteen stone, or 196 pounds, in training.
claims.excerpt: weighs what in England is termed fourteen stone

claims.statement: Tom Allen agreed to meet George Rooke for $2,500 and the championship of America, but the match fell through over a difficulty about the stakeholders.
claims.excerpt: Tom Alien also shortly after agreed to meet Rooke ior $2,500 and the championship otf

fights.excerpt: Blip the £200 and more beside, meet at St.
fights.notes: Forthcoming in about fourteen or sixteen days from 13 March 1878; no result in this article. Law may interfere.

fights.excerpt: Tom Alien also shortly after agreed to meet Rooke ior $2,500 and the championship otf
fights.notes: Agreed match that fell through over a difficulty about the stakeholders; never fought.

notes: Trainer and ring details from a Cincinnati Enquirer letter dated London, 13 March 1878.
